overall_summary: Deduplicated analysis of FACTVERSE observations reveals that extreme space scenario hooks and 'What If' planetary drops (e.g., liquid diamond, burning ice, dark planets) significantly outperform standard factual statements in views-per-day and engagement metrics (likes-per-view). Videos published within the late September / early October window demonstrate substantially higher velocity than older September backlog items, proving that high-stakes exploratory space questions and vivid visual scenarios drive superior YouTube Shorts performance.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) accumulated over 1,000 and 972 views respectively in under a month, showing high velocity compared to older static facts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on high-stakes hypothetical survival or immersion scenarios dealing with extreme cosmic environments.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles detailing rare planetary phenomena like 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (A9Qa-RmuOr0) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (v1rrcZLdp4U) drove heavy view counts (981 and 1030 views) with strong like ratios.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more short-form pieces focusing on bizarre, counter-intuitive exoplanet physics and orbital anomalies.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like 'The Psychological Trick to Stop Songs Stuck in Your Head' (ef3ND4qiRHc) and brain memory tricks stagnated below 100 views with minimal engagement relative to space content.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize psychological trivia and micro-stories regarding everyday life in favor of high-visual-impact science and space niches.

weak_patterns.pattern: Static Historical or General Knowledge Statements
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'The 2,000-Year-Old Mystery Science Can't Solve' (yLm-FjYH6-k) and standard animal facts garnered weak view acceleration.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid vague historical mysteries unless tied to a visceral, high-velocity narrative or extreme hypothetical framework.
